scope: FP-SHARED-DP-CUT: break slot/operand mux -> shared scalar add/shift -> accumulator -> response mux in fp_exec/scalar_unit release path; keep single outstanding, ordered commit, raw-bit semantics; update lcvex_fp_exec_tb latency assertions.

implementation.summary: In the FP_ITER=1 release branch of lcvex_fp_scalar, removed the old full combinational scalar-result computation for all staged operations; only FMOV remains direct combinational. In lcvex_fp_exec, added TX_SLOT and per-slot capture registers (slot_result_r/slot_int_result_r/slot_fpsr_r/slot_cmp_nzcv_r) so accumulator and response construction use a frozen scalar result one cycle after slot_done. This breaks the slot/operand mux -> shared datapath -> accumulator/response mux long combinational cone. Latency assertions updated for the added capture cycle.

semantics.raw_bit: unchanged; staged finish functions still use the same raw-bit helpers
semantics.commit_order: unchanged; still single outstanding fp_exec transaction and one held response
semantics.fpsr_fpcr: unchanged; FPCR snapshot at request acceptance, FPSR OR behavior preserved
semantics.kill_reset: slot_*_r cleared on kill/reset; no ghost response

runs.notes: Verilator lint-only on lcvex_core with release filelist

runs.command: conda run -n lcvex verilator --binary --timing --assert -j 1 --top-module lcvex_fp_exec_tb rtl/lcvex_pkg.sv rtl/lcvex_fp_scalar.sv rtl/lcvex_neon_fp.sv tb/sv/lcvex_fp_exec_tb.sv && ./obj_dir_fp_exec/lcvex_fp_exec_tb
runs.notes: Includes updated latency assertions (scalar 4, NEON 2S 7, FDIV/FSQRT +1/+2), single issue, held response, kill/reset

known_limits: No physical timing run in this task; actual Fmax/slack must be confirmed by next FP-P5 rerun.
If STA still shows fp_exec top-N, likely next cut is inside finish_pre/round_pack or finish_* (further normalize/round split).
FP latency increased by one capture cycle per slot; performance impact must be evaluated by FP-P4/perf matrix.
EMIF/sys CDC hold/recovery negatives remain outside this task (T-20260902-027).
